messages:
Noah (AE): Aurora Health wants a short POC next month. Key asks in their security questionnaire: SCIM bulk imports + ordering guarantees, SAML encrypted assertions + specific ciphers, multi-domain TXT verification automation, IDP->RBAC mapping with attribute-based roles, and whether Dedicated is needed for SSO peaks. Can SE/Infra/Sec confirm constraints?
Priya (SE): SCIM: we support v2 with PATCH and bulk CSV ingestion. For initial 35k import we recommend CSV + background apply. We don't provide strict linear ordering for deltas (best-effort). If they need strict ordering we can add idempotency keys/seq numbers in their provisioning pipeline.
Hannah (Security): SAML encryption: we support assertion + NameID encryption with customer certs. Confirm algorithms: they requested RSA-OAEP and AES-256-GCM. That's supported. We can encrypt attributes too (email, roles). Need SP metadata and preferred cert.
Marco (Infra): Private/VPC POC takes ~10 business days. Hosted with region pin + CMK is 48-72h. For POC speed recommend hosted with customer-managed KMS if they need CMKs.
Priya (SE): RBAC: pattern = SCIM groups -> Redwood roles; SAML attribute claims -> session-scoped elevations. Example mapping snippet I'll paste to the FAQ. Also ask customer for sample group names and attribute names.
Hannah (Security): Session revocation: we offer deprovision webhook + token blacklist. Hosted propagation is best-effort (<60s typical). If customer requires hard guarantees, Dedicated can have stronger SLAs. Note: long-lived SP-side cookies can outlive token revocation.
Jules (Legal): They flagged SOC2 + DPA and asked for data residency (US-only). We'll supply SOC2 and DPA. For residency, hosted region pin covers it; Dedicated/private if they need physical isolation.
Noah (AE): Can we get a short checklist I can give their security team?
Priya (SE): I'll prepare a 1-page FAQ: SCIM limits and bulk path, SAML encryption options, RBAC mapping examples, session revoke behavior, and required artifacts (SP metadata xml, sample CSV, domains list, KMS ARN).
Marco (Infra): I'll draft the provisioning timeline for hosted vs private and post the network checklist.
deploy-bot: Action scheduled: "poc-hosted-boost" will run in staging in 3h to increase SCIM throughput for test window. Reply "cancel" to abort.
Noah (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll collect their artifacts and send over. If they push Dedicated, we'll loop in sales ops for commercials.
